newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING - SPEEDY FONTANELLI HANGS ON.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING - SPEEDY FONTANELLI HANGS ON.

text.p: Fabiano Fontanelli hung on to triumph in a tingling finish to the 16th stage of the Giro d'Italia on Monday.
Fontanelli held off fellow Italians Fabio Roscioli and Angelo Lecchi as the pursing pack closed in after a 158 kms leg from Borgomanero raced at 45.34 kph over a flatlands course.
The first four held off a charging mass who had chased them for most of the final 62 kms as six riders built a 50- seconds advantage which dropped to 12 seconds then doubled and fell again .
Giro leader Ivan Gotti kept his lead of 51 seconds over Russian Pavel Tonkov as they finished in the same time, 3:29:05, as the winner.
